title: A House to Let
author: Charles Dickens · Wilkie Collins · Elizabeth Cleghorn Gaskell · Adelaide Anne Procter
description: "A House to Let" by Dickens, Collins, Gaskell, and Procter is a collaborative novella published in 1858 in the Christmas edition of Household Words magazine.
longDescription: An elderly woman named Sophonisba becomes intrigued by mysterious signs of life in a supposedly empty, dilapidated house across from her own.

authorInfo.bio: Charles Dickens · Wilkie Collins · Elizabeth Cleghorn Gaskell · Adelaide Anne Procter (1812–1870) wrote A House to Let. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
authorInfo.edition: Complete historical source edition, with original credits and licence retained.
